entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...That "medicine," huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So... which conversation of mine did you[n]eavesdrop on to hear that?
entries.uk: То... яку саме мою розмову ти[n]підслухав, щоб про це дізнатися?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It was obvious, actually. You call that[n]hiding?
entries.uk: Насправді це було очевидно. І це ти[n]називаєш «сховатися»?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Not that I care, of course.
entries.uk: ...Не те щоб мені було не байдуже.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was going to dispose of that medicine[n]anyway. I got a little too carried away[n]with it.
entries.uk: Я й так збиралася знищити ті ліки.[n]Трохи захопилася ними.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...But tell me; why would a high schooler[n]like yourself be so interested in that[n]medicine?
entries.uk: ...Але скажи: чому такого старшокласника,[n]як ти, так цікавлять ці ліки?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's very strange, indeed. You don't seem[n]to be very athletic, so...
entries.uk: Справді дивно. Ти не схожий[n]на спортсмена, тож...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...What exactly are you up to?
It's for brainpower.
It's for my exams.
It's for studying.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Brainpower...? Oh, for your entrance[n]exams?
entries.uk: Щоб краще думалося...? А, для[n]вступних іспитів?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Exams...? Oh, your entrance exams for[n]college?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Studying...? Oh, for your entrance exams?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So you're looking to improve your[n]concentration and reduce fatigue?[n]Hm, that's not the best idea.
entries.uk: Тобто хочеш краще зосереджуватися[n]й менше втомлюватися? Хм, це[n]не найкраща ідея.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But if that's what you want to do...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Then good luck with that.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I have no obligation to help you with[n]that. Why don't you have an energy[n]drink or something?
entries.uk: Я не зобов'язана тобі з цим допомагати.[n]Випий енергетик абощо.

entries.en: I need that medicine.
I'll tell people.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You're really annoying, you know that?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The medicine is really expensive.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: And it's not something a high schooler[n]can get his hands on. It costs almost[n]as much as a car.
entries.uk: Старшокласникові таке не по кишені.[n]Вони коштують майже як[n]автомобіль.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Got it? So how about you just go home?
I'm not leaving.
Can I work for it?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What, like part-time help?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Do you consider yourself someone[n]with a good amount of stamina?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I admit I have been looking for a young[n]person around your age to help me out.
entries.uk: Визнаю, я шукала когось молодого,[n]приблизно твого віку, на допомогу.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But I haven't been able to find one, even[n]after putting an ad in the paper.
entries.uk: Але так нікого й не знайшла, навіть[n]після оголошення в газеті.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Are you up for it?
What would I be doing?
How much does it pay?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Do you want to do it or not?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Let's just say that it'll be worth it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Okay then. You'll be participating in[n]clinical trials for my medicine.
entries.uk: Ну гаразд. Ти братимеш участь[n]у клінічних випробуваннях моїх ліків.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hang on. I'll be right back.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Here you go.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Worried about the side effects, huh?[n]Well, you can relax.
entries.uk: ...Боїшся побічних ефектів, га?[n]Що ж, можеш не хвилюватися.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Rest assured, my autopsy is guaranteed[n]to find out exactly what part of it[n]killed you.
entries.uk: Будь певен, мій розтин точно[n]покаже, яка саме складова[n]тебе вбила.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What, aren't you going to take it?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The exit's right there if you want to leave.
entries.uk: Вихід он там, якщо хочеш піти.

entries.en: If I don't drink this, Takemi probably[n]won't sell me her medicine...
entries.uk: Якщо я це не вип'ю, Такемі, мабуть,[n]не продасть мені своїх ліків...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well? Go on.
Don't mind if I do.
Bottoms up.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I can't believe you actually drank it...
entries.uk: Не можу повірити, що ти справді випив...

entries.en: Bitter, yet sour. It's beyond description...
entries.uk: Гірке й водночас кисле. Це не описати...

entries.en: ...However, it's nothing I can't handle...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Wow... Still doing okay, huh? Hm.[n]Not bad, for a high schooler.
entries.uk: Ого... Досі тримаєшся, га? Хм.[n]Непогано, як для старшокласника.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Uh...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Welp. Game over, I guess.
